steps.speaker: Mother
steps.content: Did you sneak off to the beach again?

steps.speaker: Mother
steps.content: How many times do I have to tell you? The sea isn't safe right now. Why can't you just listen?

steps.speaker: Mother
steps.content: What's so good about the water anyway? Why don't you go make friends with children your age instead? Don't make things harder for me...

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: ...Your mother's right. I know you're always finding excuses to go to the beach, but, well...

steps.speaker: Father
steps.content: At least try not to make people think you're a freak...
